annotations.title: Multi-chain wallet balances in USD (curated tokens)

description: Balances of an EVM wallet (0x address, ENS name or Basename) on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon and Avalanche: native coin plus a curated list of 9-13 major tokens per chain (USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, WBTC/cbBTC, AERO, ARB, OP and more), USD values, per-chain and total USD, chains holding funds, and native USDC per chain for x402 payments. Sources: each chain's JSON-RPC via PublicNode; prices from on-chain Uniswap v3 and Velodrome pools. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

address.description: Wallet as a 0x EVM address, or an ASCII ENS name (vitalik.eth) or Basename (jesse.base.eth) resolved to its ETH address record.

chains.description: Comma-separated chains by name or chain id: base (8453), ethereum (1), arbitrum (42161), optimism (10), polygon (137), avalanche (43114). Default: all six.
